scenes.hook: Build this profile card with a name, a short bio, and one useful link.
scenes.idea: Use an article for the card, a heading for the name, and a paragraph for the introduction.
scenes.code: Give the article a class called card. The same class connects it to your style rule.
scenes.result: Add padding for breathing room. A border and rounded corners turn the content into a card.
scenes.tip: Keep the text readable against your background. Simple colors work well.
scenes.caution: If you add a portrait, write alternative text that describes its purpose.
scenes.try: Now replace Alex with your name, change the bio, and add your own link.
scenes.close: Subscribe to Tech at sixty for more small coding projects.
